title: Hof backup manifest
description: Written into the staging tree (ADR 0006's own Backup Flow step 8) and so into every destination's own snapshot alongside it - the one document restore reads BEFORE trusting anything else in the snapshot. Carries the same digest quartet state-v1.schema.json already uses so restore can verify this snapshot's own generated config against a real, independently-verifiable signed historical release lock, without ever having to trust the snapshot's own unsigned content alone.

consistencySet.description: Same shape as backup-plan-v1's own consistencySet (copied, not $ref'd) - exactly what this snapshot actually contains, so restore can confirm the volume set it's about to recreate matches what this manifest claims before restoring a single byte.

sanitizedManifestIncluded.description: Whether the staging tree included a sanitized copy of services.yml (secretRef names only, never a resolved secret value).

recoveryStoreIncluded.description: Whether the staging tree included the encrypted recovery copy of application/TLS/backup secrets - always true for a real backup; false only ever appears on a fixture/test document.
